keywords.name: [Rush]
text: A Character with Rush can attack on the same turn it is played. Normally, Characters must wait until the next turn.

keywords.name: [Rush: Character]
text: A Character with Rush: Character can attack opponent's Characters on the turn it is played, but not the opponent's Leader.

keywords.name: [Double Attack]
text: When this card deals damage to the opponent's Leader, it deals 2 damage instead of 1. The opponent processes 2 Life cards.

keywords.name: [Banish]
text: When this card deals damage to the opponent's Leader, the Life card is trashed directly — it is not added to their hand, and its [Trigger] cannot be activated.

keywords.name: [Blocker]
text: During the Block Step, you may rest this Character to have it take the place of the target being attacked. The attacker now faces the Blocker instead.
Only one Blocker can be activated per battle.

keywords.name: [Unblockable]
text: When this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate [Blocker]. The attack cannot be redirected and will hit its intended target.

keywords.name: [On Play]
text: An effect that automatically activates when this Character or Stage card is played onto the field.

keywords.name: [When Attacking]
text: An effect that automatically activates when this card declares an attack during your Attack Step.

keywords.name: [On Block]
text: An effect that automatically activates when this card uses its [Blocker] ability during the Block Step.

keywords.name: [On K.O.]
text: An effect that activates when this Character is K.O.'d (trashed by battle or effect). The effect activates on the field, but resolves after the card is in the trash.
Only activates when the card moves to an open area — K.O.'d is different from being trashed by other means (e.g., making room for a 6th Character).

keywords.name: [On Your Opponent's Attack]
text: An effect that activates when your opponent declares an attack, after their [When Attacking] effects have resolved.

keywords.name: [End of Your Turn]
text: An effect that activates during the End Phase of your turn. If you have multiple, you choose the activation order.

keywords.name: [End of Your Opponent's Turn]
text: An effect that activates during the End Phase of your opponent's turn. If the opponent has multiple, they choose the order.

keywords.name: [Activate: Main]
text: An effect you can manually activate during your Main Phase (but not during a battle). Pay any listed activation cost to use it.

keywords.name: [Main]
text: Found on Event cards. You can play this Event during your Main Phase (not during battle) by paying its cost. After resolving, the card goes to the trash.

keywords.name: [Counter]
text: Found on Event cards. You can play this Event during the Counter Step of your opponent's attack by paying its cost. After resolving, the card goes to the trash.
Counter cannot be activated by other card effects unless the effect specifically says "activate [Counter]".

keywords.name: [Once Per Turn]
text: This effect can only be activated and resolved once during each turn. If the card moves to another area and returns, it's treated as a new card and can activate again.

keywords.name: [Your Turn]
text: This effect's condition is only met during your own turn. The effect is inactive during your opponent's turn.

keywords.name: [Opponent's Turn]
text: This effect's condition is only met during your opponent's turn. The effect is inactive during your own turn.

keywords.name: [DON!! xX]
text: This effect's condition is met when this card has X or more DON!! cards attached to it (from the Give DON!! action). The effect only activates when the DON!! threshold is reached.

keywords.name: DON!! -X
text: A cost requirement: return a total of X DON!! cards from your Leader area, Character area, and/or cost area back to your DON!! deck. Active or rested — both count.

keywords.name: Rest Symbol
text: A cost requirement: rest the specified number of active DON!! cards in your cost area. The number in the circle symbol tells you how many DON!! to rest (e.g. a circled 1 means rest 1 DON!!).
This is the most common activation cost — you read the number in the symbol as the number of DON!! to rest.

keywords.name: [Trigger]
text: When a Life card with [Trigger] is added to your hand from taking damage, you may reveal it and activate its [Trigger] effect instead of adding it to your hand.
You can choose not to activate it and add the card to your hand normally. After resolving a [Trigger], the card is trashed unless the effect says otherwise.

keywords.name: K.O.
text: A Character card being trashed as a result of losing a battle or a card effect. K.O.'d cards go to the trash.
Trashing a Character to make room for a 6th Character (the 5-card limit rule) is NOT a K.O. — [On K.O.] won't trigger.
